common.sentence: 두 후보의 표 차이가 한 표로 근소했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 근소하- + -였어요 contracts to 근소했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 표 차이가 한 표로 근소했어요: the gap was a small one vote.

common.sentence: 예약하려면 최소한 하루 전에 연락해 주세요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 최소한 하루 전에: at least one day in advance; earlier is also possible.

common.sentence: 남은 시간 동안 최대한 많은 책을 정리할게요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 최대한 많은 책: as many books as possible within the remaining time.

common.sentence: 남은 재료로는 기껏해야 세 접시를 만들 수 있어요.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 기껏해야 [기꺼태야]. The final ㅅ and following ㅎ combine as an aspirated ㅌ.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 기껏해야 세 접시: at most three servings; reaching three is not guaranteed.

common.sentence: 한 시간을 기다렸는데 상담은 고작 오 분이었어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 고작 오 분: only five minutes, presented as disappointingly brief.

common.sentence: 손님 열 명을 예상했는데 무려 서른 명이 왔어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 무려 서른 명: thirty people, a surprisingly large number compared with the expected ten.

common.sentence: 길이 막혀서 기차 출발 직전에 겨우 도착했어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 직전에 겨우 도착했어요: managed to arrive just before departure despite the delay.

common.sentence: 이 상자를 옮기려면 적어도 두 사람이 필요해요.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 적어도 [저거도]. The final ㄱ of 적 links to the following vowel.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 적어도 두 사람: two or more people.

common.sentence: 남은 좌석은 많아야 다섯 개일 거예요.

language_specific.morphology: 많- + -아야 yields 많아야, expressing an estimated upper bound.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 많아야 다섯 개: no more than an estimated five seats.

common.sentence: 세 명 이상이면 출발해요. 세 명도 돼요.
common.part_of_speech: noun and copula with conditional ending

language_specific.morphology: 이상 + 이다 + -(으)면 yields 이상이면.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 세 명 이상이면: if there are three or more people, including exactly three.

common.sentence: 짐은 두 개 이하로 가져오세요. 두 개도 돼요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 두 개 이하로: at most two items, including exactly two.

common.sentence: 다섯 명 미만이면 작은 방을 써요. 다섯 명은 안 돼요.
common.part_of_speech: noun and copula with conditional ending

language_specific.morphology: 미만 + 이다 + -(으)면 yields 미만이면.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 다섯 명 미만이면: if there are fewer than five people; exactly five is excluded.

common.sentence: 빨간 공 1개와 파란 공 2개에서 무작위로 뽑으면 빨간색일 확률은 1/3이에요.

language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 확률은 [황뉴른]; ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㄱ, ㄱ nasalizes, and final ㄹ links to 은.

common.sentence: 아직 투표함도 열지 않았는데 결과를 예단하면 안 돼요.

language_specific.morphology: 예단하- + -면 gives 예단하면, the conditional form of 예단하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 결과를 예단하다: judge the outcome before the evidence is available.

common.sentence: 불이 꺼진 걸 보고 지수가 집에 없다고 짐작했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 짐작하- + -였어요 contracts to 짐작했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 집에 없다고 짐작하다: guess that someone is not home.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 짐작했어요 [짐자캐써요]; ㄱ and ㅎ combine as ㅋ, and past ㅆ links to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 비가 계속 내려서 내일 경기가 열릴지는 불투명해요.

language_specific.morphology: 불투명하- + -여요 contracts to 불투명해요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 경기가 열릴지는 불투명하다: it is uncertain whether the game will take place.

common.sentence: 쪽지에 이름이 없어서 누가 썼는지 불분명해요.

language_specific.morphology: 불분명하- + -여요 contracts to 불분명해요.

common.sentence: 신청자가 적어서 공연이 열릴지는 미지수예요.

language_specific.morphology: 미지수 + 이- + -에요 contracts to 미지수예요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 공연이 열릴지는 미지수이다: whether the performance will happen is unknown.

common.sentence: 막차가 떠났고 다른 교통편도 없어 오늘 안에 도착할 가망이 없어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 도착할 가망이 없다: there is no prospect of arriving.

common.sentence: 안내문에 ‘음식 반입 금지’라고 명시적으로 적혀 있어요.

language_specific.morphology: 명시적 + 으로 forms the adverbial 명시적으로.

common.sentence: 시의 ‘빈 의자’는 떠난 사람을 암시적으로 떠올리게 해요.

language_specific.morphology: 암시적 + 으로 forms the adverbial 암시적으로.

common.sentence: 그날 찍은 사진 속 내리는 눈은 눈이 왔다는 증거예요.

language_specific.morphology: 증거 + 이- + -에요 contracts to 증거예요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 눈이 왔다는 증거: evidence that it snowed.

common.sentence: 동화에서 젖은 발자국은 누군가 지나갔다는 정황 증거예요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 지나갔다는 정황 증거: indirect evidence that someone passed by.

common.sentence: 관객 수는 아직 세지 않아서 이 숫자는 추정에 불과해요.

language_specific.morphology: 추정 + 에 combines with 불과하- + -여요, contracted as 불과해요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 추정에 불과하다: amount to no more than an estimate.

common.sentence: 편지에 날짜가 없어서 쓴 날짜는 추측일 뿐이에요.

language_specific.morphology: 추측 + 이- + -ㄹ gives 추측일; the dependent noun 뿐 is followed by 이- + -에요, giving 뿐이에요.

common.sentence: 사진 한 장만으로는 그곳이 어디인지 단언할 수 없어요.

language_specific.morphology: 단언하- + -ㄹ modifies 수, followed by the negative predicate 없어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 어디인지 단언할 수 없다: cannot state categorically where it is.

common.sentence: 게시글의 날짜는 원본과 대조하지 않아 검증되지 않았어요.

language_specific.morphology: 검증되- + -지 combines with 않- + -았어요 to form the past negative.

common.sentence: 자료가 부족해서 그 그림이 민수의 작품이라는 주장은 입증되지 않았어요.

language_specific.morphology: 입증되- + -지 combines with 않- + -았어요 to form the past negative.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 입증되지 않았어요 [입쯩되지 아나써요]; ㅈ in 증 becomes tense, and ㄶ loses ㅎ before ㄴ links to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 모임은 토요일로 논의 중이지만 날짜가 확정된 것은 아니에요.

language_specific.morphology: 확정되- + -ㄴ modifies 것; 은 marks the topic, and 아니에요 denies that classification.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 확정된 [확쩡된]; ㅈ in 정 is tense after ㄱ.

common.sentence: 이 상자의 카드 다섯 장은 모두 파란색이라 예외가 없어요.

language_specific.morphology: 예외 + 가 is the subject of 없어요, the polite form of 없다.

common.sentence: 예보가 엇갈려 오늘 비가 온다는 예보가 확실한 것은 아니에요.

language_specific.morphology: 확실하- + -ㄴ modifies 것; 은 marks the topic, and 아니에요 denies certainty.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 확실한 [확씰한]; ㅅ in 실 is tense after ㄱ.

common.sentence: 길이 막힐 가능성은 아직 배제할 수 없어요.

language_specific.morphology: 배제하- + -ㄹ modifies 수, followed by the negative predicate 없어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 가능성을 배제할 수 없다: cannot rule out the possibility.

common.sentence: 수진이는 다음 독서 모임에 참여할 의향이 있어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 참여할 의향이 있다: be willing to participate.

common.sentence: 민호는 끝까지 한국어를 배우겠다는 의지가 강해요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 배우겠다는 의지가 강하다: be strongly determined to learn.

common.sentence: 지연은 동생에게 주말에 책을 돌려주기로 확약했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 확약하- + -였어요 contracts to 확약했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 동생에게 돌려주기로 확약하다: firmly promise a younger sibling to return something.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 확약했어요 [화갸캐써요]; ㄱ links to 약, ㄱ and ㅎ combine as ㅋ, and past ㅆ links to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 긴 연습을 견딜 각오로 합창단에 들어갔어요.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 각오 [가고]. The final ㄱ links to the following vowel.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 연습을 견딜 각오로: with readiness to endure practice.

common.sentence: 동아리는 올해 공연을 야외에서 열기로 결정했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 결정하- + -였어요 contracts to 결정했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 공연을 열기로 결정하다: decide to hold a performance.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 결정했어요 [결쩡해써요]; ㅈ is tense after ㄹ, and past ㅆ links to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 동아리 회장에게는 회원들의 의견을 듣는 책무가 있어요.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 책무 [챙무]. The final ㄱ nasalizes before ㅁ.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 의견을 듣는 책무: the duty to listen to opinions.

common.sentence: 우리 모임 규칙상 당번은 열쇠를 반납할 의무가 있어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 열쇠를 반납할 의무가 있다: be obliged to return the key.

common.sentence: 저는 친구의 말을 끝까지 들으려고 노력하고 있어요.

language_specific.morphology: 노력하- + -고 combines with 있- + -어요 to express an ongoing effort.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 들으려고 노력하다: try to listen.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 노력하고 [노려카고]; ㄱ and ㅎ combine as ㅋ.

common.sentence: 이번 발표 준비에 최선을 다했지만 아쉬운 점도 있었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 최선 + 을 combines with 다하- + -였지만, contracted as 다했지만.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 준비에 최선을 다하다: do one's utmost in preparation.

common.sentence: 민지는 포스터를 만들겠다고 했지만 만들지 않아 약속 불이행을 사과했어요.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 불이행 [불리행]. An inserted ㄴ becomes ㄹ after the preceding ㄹ.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 약속 불이행: failure to carry out a promise.

common.sentence: 다시 만나기로 했지만 날짜는 아직 기약이 없어요.

language_specific.morphology: 기약 + 이 is the subject of 없어요, the polite form of 없다.

common.sentence: 유나는 여러 해 동안 마을 도서관 운영에 헌신했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 헌신하- + -였어요 contracts to 헌신했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 도서관 운영에 헌신하다: devote oneself to running a library.

common.sentence: 현우는 맡은 전시 준비에 책임감을 느껴 매일 진행 상황을 확인해요.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 책임 [채김] within 책임감; ㄱ links to the following vowel.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 준비에 책임감을 느끼다: feel responsible for the preparations.

common.sentence: 매주 걷겠다는 계획을 실천에 옮겨 오늘 공원을 걸었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 실천 + 에 combines with 옮기- + -어, contracted as 옮겨.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 계획을 실천에 옮기다: put a plan into practice.

common.sentence: 아무도 맡지 않은 안내를 소라가 자원했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 자원하- + -였어요 contracts to 자원했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 안내를 자원하다: volunteer to guide people.

common.sentence: 발표 요청의 수락 여부는 아직 확인되지 않았어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 요청의 수락 여부: whether a request is accepted.

common.sentence: 작가는 독자 모임의 낭독 요청에 응낙했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 응낙하- + -였어요 contracts to 응낙했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 낭독 요청에 응낙하다: agree to a request to give a reading.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 응낙했어요 [응나캐써요]; ㄱ and ㅎ combine as ㅋ, and past ㅆ links to the following vowel.
language_specific.social_context: A formal expression describes the writer's agreement to the readers' request.

common.sentence: 지수는 민호와 매달 첫 일요일에 만나기로 약정했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 약정하- + -였어요 contracts to 약정했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 민호와 만나기로 약정하다: agree with Minho to meet.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 약정했어요 [약쩡해써요]; ㅈ is tense after ㄱ, and past ㅆ links to the following vowel.
language_specific.social_context: A formal expression describes an agreement between 지수 and 민호.

common.sentence: 토요일에는 선약이 있어서 친구의 영화 초대를 거절했어요.

language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 선약이 [서냐기]; ㄴ links to 약, and final ㄱ links to 이.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 선약이 있다: have a prior appointment.

common.sentence: 민지는 함께 정리하면 돕겠다는 조건을 달았어요.

language_specific.morphology: 조건 + 을 combines with 달- + -았어요, giving 달았어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 함께 정리하면 돕겠다는 조건을 달다: make the promise to help conditional on tidying together.

common.sentence: 동생이 농담을 하더니 친구가 웃었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 하- + -더니 forms 하더니, linking the observed action to a related later reaction.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker describes a younger sibling's joke and a friend's reaction.

common.sentence: 아까는 조용하더니 지금은 이야기를 잘하네요.

language_specific.morphology: 조용하- + -더니 becomes 조용하더니. The connective contrasts an observed earlier state with the current one.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker comments on a person's changed behavior.

common.sentence: 친구에게 물었더니 이미 책을 읽었대요.

language_specific.morphology: 묻- + -었- + -더니 becomes 물었더니; ㄷ changes to ㄹ before the vowel. The completed question leads to a discovered response.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker reports what a friend said in response to a question.

common.sentence: 비가 오니 이웃과 실내에서 만나요.

language_specific.morphology: 오- + -니 becomes 오니. The short connective attaches to the vowel stem and gives the reason for meeting indoors.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker proposes meeting a neighbor indoors because it is raining.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 비가 오다: rain falls.

common.sentence: 자리가 좁으니 의자를 옮길게요.

language_specific.morphology: 좁- + -으니 becomes 좁으니. The short connective attaches to the consonant stem and gives a reason.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker offers to move a chair because the space is cramped.

common.sentence: 늦은 친구에게 시간을 지키면 좋겠다고 에둘러 말했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 에두르- + -어 becomes 에둘러 through 르 irregular inflection.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker indirectly raises punctuality with a friend who arrived late.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 에둘러 말하다: express a point indirectly.

common.sentence: 소리가 크다고 못 하고 조금 조용하면 좋겠다고 돌려 말했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 돌리- + -어 contracts to 돌려, followed by 말하- + -였- + -어요, contracted as 말했어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker describes raising a noise problem indirectly.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 돌려 말하다: put a point indirectly.

common.sentence: 친구에게 밀린 돈 이야기를 넌지시 꺼냈어요.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker gently raises an overdue payment with a friend.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 돈 이야기를 넌지시 꺼내다: subtly bring up the topic of money.

common.sentence: 그 평론은 영화의 뻔한 결말을 꼬집었어요.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: "꼬집었어요" [꼬지버써요]. The final ㅂ moves to the following vowel, and ㅆ begins the next syllable.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 결말을 꼬집다: point out a flaw in the ending.

common.sentence: 늦었다고 핀잔을 듣고 친구는 조용해졌어요.

language_specific.morphology: 핀잔 + 을 marks the reproach as the object; 듣- + -고 links receiving it to the next event.
language_specific.social_context: A friend becomes quiet after being reproached for being late.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 핀잔을 듣다: receive a reproach.

common.sentence: 친구가 실수할 때마다 그는 ‘천재네’라고 빈정거렸어요.

language_specific.social_context: The narrator reports a person’s mockery of a friend’s repeated mistakes; the quoted taunt is casual, and the framing is informal polite.
language_specific.morphology: 빈정거리- + -었- + -어요 contracts to 빈정거렸어요 through ㅣ + 어 → 여.

common.sentence: 한 시간 늦은 친구를 ‘참 일찍 왔네’라고 비꼬았어요.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker sarcastically addresses a friend who is an hour late with casual quoted speech; the framing is informal polite.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 친구를 비꼬다: make a sarcastic remark directed at a friend.

common.sentence: 인사했는데 못 들었는지 그냥 지나가서 무안했어요.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker feels embarrassed after a greeting goes unanswered.
language_specific.morphology: 무안하- + -였- + -어요 contracts to 무안했어요.

common.sentence: 회의에서 제 의견을 비웃는 소리에 모욕감을 느꼈어요.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: "모욕감을" [모욕까믈]. ㄱ after the preceding stop is tense, and the final ㅁ moves to the following vowel.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker felt insulted when their opinion was laughed at in a meeting.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 모욕감을 느끼다: feel insulted.

common.sentence: 동생보다 못한다는 비교에 자존심이 상했어요.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker's pride is hurt by a comparison with a younger sibling.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 자존심이 상하다: have one's pride hurt.

common.sentence: 제 농담이 친구의 기분을 상하게 했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 기분 + 을 is followed by 상하- + -게 하다; 하- + -였어요 contracts to 했어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker says their joke hurt a friend's feelings.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 친구의 기분을 상하게 하다: hurt a friend's feelings.

common.sentence: 내 말을 자꾸 끊어서 언짢았어요.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: "언짢았어요" [언짜나써요]. Before a vowel, the surviving ㄴ links to the next syllable; ㅆ begins the following syllable.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker was displeased because someone kept interrupting.

common.sentence: 서로 싸운 두 사람 사이에 앉기가 거북했어요.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: "거북했어요" [거부캐써요]. ㄱ and ㅎ combine as aspirated ㅋ, and ㅆ begins the following syllable.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker felt awkward sitting between two people who had quarreled.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 앉기가 거북하다: feel awkward about sitting.
language_specific.morphology: 거북하- + -였- + -어요 contracts to 거북했어요.

common.sentence: 허락 없이 사진을 올려서 불쾌했어요.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker expresses displeasure at a photo being posted without permission.
language_specific.morphology: 불쾌하- + -였- + -어요 contracts to 불쾌했어요.

common.sentence: 주말에 일이 있어서 주말 회의가 달갑지 않았어요.

language_specific.morphology: 달갑- + -지 않다 forms the negative; 않- + -았어요 gives 않았어요. The ㅂ remains before -지.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker finds the weekend meeting unwelcome because they already have work that weekend.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 회의가 달갑지 않다: find a meeting unwelcome.

common.sentence: 그 말씀도 일리는 있지만 예산이 부족해요.

language_specific.morphology: 일리 + 는 adds contrast, and 있- + -지만 introduces the reservation.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker acknowledges another person's point while raising a budget concern.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 말씀에 일리가 있다: a point has some merit.

common.sentence: 비용 절감에는 동의하지만 인원 감축은 반대해요.

language_specific.morphology: 동의하- + -지만 forms 동의하지만, acknowledging the goal before contrasting the proposed means.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker agrees with reducing costs but opposes cutting staff.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 비용 절감에 동의하다: agree with cost reduction as a goal.

common.sentence: 저는 희망적이라고 생각하지 않고 열린 결말로 봐요.
common.meaning: see it as an open ending

language_specific.morphology: 열리- + -ㄴ forms 열린; 결말 + 로 marks the interpretation, and 보- + -아요 contracts to 봐요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker offers a personal interpretation of an ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 열린 결말로 보다: interpret it as an open ending.

common.sentence: 예산이 줄었으니 행사 규모를 다시 생각해 주실까요?

language_specific.morphology: 생각하- + -여 contracts to 생각해; 주- + -시- + -ㄹ까요 forms the respectful tentative request 주실까요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks someone to reconsider the event's scale because the budget has fallen.

common.sentence: 자료가 한 건뿐이라 모두 그렇다는 주장에는 수긍하기 어려워요.

language_specific.morphology: 수긍하- + -기 nominalizes the verb; 어렵- + -어요 becomes 어려워요 through ㅂ irregular inflection.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 주장에 수긍하기 어렵다: find a claim hard to accept.

common.sentence: 일부가 좋아졌으니 ‘모두 성공’보다 일부 개선은 어떨까요?

language_specific.social_context: The speaker suggests less categorical wording while retaining the evidence of improvement.
language_specific.morphology: 일부 개선 + 은 marks the suggested wording; 어떨까요 is the tentative question form of 어떻다 with ㅎ deletion.

common.sentence: 발표가 명확해서 좋았어요. 다만 글씨가 조금 작았어요.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker praises a clear presentation and adds a specific caveat about the text size.

common.sentence: "곧"이라는 게 이번 주를 뜻하나요?

language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks what an ambiguous time expression means.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이번 주를 뜻하다: mean this week.

common.sentence: 엄마, 차로 가자고 하셨지만 길이 막히니까 기차로 가면 어떨까요?

language_specific.morphology: 가- + -면 gives a suggested condition, followed by 어떻- + -ㄹ까요 to ask tentatively.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker politely suggests taking a train after their mother proposed going by car.

common.sentence: 친구: 결말 좋았지? 나: 난 오히려 아쉬웠어.

language_specific.social_context: Two friends use casual speech: one praises the ending, and the other expresses a contrasting disappointment.

common.sentence: 회의 시간 단축안에는 이견이 있습니다.

language_specific.morphology: 이견 + 이 marks the subject; 있- + -습니다 gives the formal polite predicate.
language_specific.social_context: A formal reservation concerns the proposal to shorten meeting time.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 안에 이견이 있다: have a differing view on a proposal.

common.sentence: 준비 시간이 하루뿐인데 내일 시행하는 건 우려돼요.

language_specific.morphology: 우려되- + -어요 contracts to 우려돼요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker raises a concern about implementing a decision with only one day to prepare.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 시행하는 것이 우려되다: be concerned about implementation.

common.sentence: 속도는 중요하지만 안전 점검까지 줄일 수는 없어요.

language_specific.morphology: 줄이- + -ㄹ 수 없다 expresses inability; 는 adds contrast before 없어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker accepts the importance of speed but resists reducing safety checks.

common.sentence: 장소 비용이 예산 내라면 동의해요.
common.meaning: agree if it is within budget

language_specific.morphology: 예산 내 takes conditional copula (이)라면 as 내라면 after the vowel-final noun; 동의하- + -여요 contracts to 동의해요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker agrees to the venue only if its cost stays within the budget.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 비용이 예산 내라면 동의하다: agree on the condition that the cost is within budget.

common.sentence: 비용은 걱정되지만 제안 전체에 반대하는 건 아니에요.
common.meaning: it does not mean I oppose

language_specific.morphology: 반대하- + -는 modifies 것; 것은 contracts to 건, followed by 아니에요 for a qualified denial.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker clarifies that concern about cost does not mean opposition to the entire proposal.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 제안에 반대하다: oppose a proposal.

common.sentence: 제가 틀릴 수도 있지만 이 수치는 줄어든 것 같아요.

language_specific.morphology: 틀리- + -ㄹ 수 있다 expresses possibility; 도 and -지만 introduce the tentative contrast.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker acknowledges possible error while offering a different reading of a figure.

common.sentence: 비용을 줄이려면 인원 감축 대신 장소를 바꾸는 건 어때요?

language_specific.social_context: The speaker suggests changing the venue instead of cutting staff to reduce costs.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 인원 감축 대신: instead of reducing staff.

common.sentence: 같은 관객 수를 보고도 인기가 유지됐다고 해석할 수 있어요.

language_specific.morphology: 해석하- + -ㄹ 수 있다 expresses a possible interpretation; 있어요 is informal polite.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker offers a possible interpretation of the same audience figures.
language_specific.lexical_frame: -다고 해석하다: interpret the evidence as indicating that.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 일정이 겹쳐 참석이 어렵습니다. 양해 부탁드립니다.

language_specific.morphology: 양해 is followed by 부탁드리- + -ㅂ니다, a formal request for understanding.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks a team leader to understand that a scheduling conflict prevents attendance.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 양해 부탁드립니다: please understand or excuse the stated difficulty.

common.sentence: 장소는 의견이 다르지만 오늘 이야기 고마웠어요.

language_specific.morphology: 이야기 names what the speaker appreciates; 고맙- + -었어요 becomes 고마웠어요 through ㅂ irregular inflection.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker ends amicably while the disagreement about the venue remains unresolved.

common.sentence: 비가 많이 온 건 맞지만, 행사를 취소할 정도는 아니에요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 건 맞지만 acknowledges the stated fact while reserving the conclusion.

common.sentence: 택시가 빠르기는 한데 요금이 부담돼요.

language_specific.morphology: 빠르- + -기는 하다 acknowledges a quality; 하- + -ㄴ데 introduces the reservation.

common.sentence: 돕고 싶은 마음은 알겠지만, 돈을 대신 내는 게 맞을까요?

language_specific.morphology: 마음 + 은 marks the intention as the acknowledged topic; 알- + -겠- + -지만 introduces the question.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 돕고 싶은 마음을 알다 acknowledges an intention to help.

common.sentence: 새 근무제의 한 달간 시범 운영에는 찬성해요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 시범 운영에 찬성하다: support a trial operation; 에는 marks the trial as the scope of support.

common.sentence: 안전 요원이 배치되면 그 수영 행사에 힘을 보탤게요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 안전 요원이 배치되면 states the condition for the speaker's support.

common.sentence: 공원 벤치는 늘리되 나무는 베지 맙시다.

language_specific.lexical_frame: -되 connects an accepted action with a following qualification or restriction.
language_specific.morphology: 늘리- + -되 forms 늘리되, accepting an increase in benches while qualifying the proposal with a prohibition on cutting trees.

common.sentence: 서운할 만해요. 그래도 일부러 뺐다는 증거는 없어요.
common.meaning: it is understandable to feel hurt

language_specific.morphology: 서운하- + -ㄹ 만하다 expresses an understandable feeling; 만하- + -여요 contracts to 만해요.

common.sentence: 새 근무제 도입은 유지비를 확인할 때까지 판단을 유보할게요.

language_specific.morphology: 판단 + 을 is the object of 유보하다; 유보하- + -ㄹ게요 expresses the speaker's decision.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 판단을 유보하다 means to withhold a judgment for now.

common.sentence: 후기가 한 건뿐이라 이 식당을 추천하기엔 근거가 부족해요.

language_specific.morphology: 근거 + 가 marks the basis as subject; 부족하- + -여요 contracts to 부족해요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 추천하기엔 근거가 부족하다 means the grounds are insufficient to recommend.

common.sentence: 축제는 찬성이에요. 다만 밤늦은 소음은 걱정돼요.

language_specific.morphology: 소음 + 은 marks the particular concern; 걱정되- + -어요 contracts to 걱정돼요.

common.sentence: 자료를 열심히 정리하셨네요. 날짜 하나만 잘못 적혔어요.

language_specific.morphology: 하나 + 만 limits the issue; 적히- + -었어요 becomes 적혔어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker recognizes the other person's effort before pointing out a remaining error.

common.sentence: 제목은 고쳤네요. 그런데 본문 날짜는 아직 틀려요.

language_specific.morphology: 아직 marks the issue as continuing; 틀리- + -어요 contracts to 틀려요.

common.sentence: 이 사진 사용은 이번만 허락해요.

language_specific.morphology: 이번 + 만 limits permission to this instance; 허락하- + -여요 contracts to 허락해요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이번만 허락하다: grant permission for this instance only.

common.sentence: 복지는 필요하지만, 이 지원금의 효과는 더 살펴봐야 해요.

language_specific.morphology: 살펴보- + -아야 하다 expresses necessity; 보아 contracts to 봐 and 하여요 to 해요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 효과를 더 살펴보다 means to examine the effects further.

common.sentence: 분리수거 확대에는 동의해요. 시행 시기는 따로 정하죠.

language_specific.morphology: 따로 modifies 정하다; 정하- + -지요 contracts to 정하죠, suggesting a separate decision.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 시기를 따로 정하다 separates the timing decision from agreement on the goal.

common.sentence: 금요일 완성은 예상일 뿐 확정은 아니에요.
common.part_of_speech: noun and copula with dependent noun

language_specific.morphology: 예상 + 이다 + -ㄹ 뿐 forms 예상일 뿐, limiting the claim to an estimate.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 예상일 뿐 확정은 아니다 contrasts an estimate with a fixed commitment.

common.sentence: 부장님, 검토 시간이 부족해 지금 제출하기가 망설여집니다.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker expresses hesitation to a department head.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 제출하기가 망설여지다 expresses hesitation about submitting.
language_specific.morphology: 망설이- + -어지- + -ㅂ니다 forms 망설여집니다, with ㅣ + 어 contracting to 여.

common.sentence: 언니, 난 바다가 더 좋지만 언니는 산에 가도 돼.

language_specific.morphology: 더 modifies 좋다 to express preference; 좋- + -지만 introduces a contrasting allowance.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker addresses an older sister with casual speech.

common.sentence: 이사 제안은 하루만 생각할 시간을 주세요.

language_specific.morphology: 생각하- + -ㄹ modifies 시간; 시간 + 을 is the object of 주다, and 주세요 is a polite request.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 생각할 시간을 주다 means to give someone time to consider.

common.sentence: 장소 변경에는 동의하지만 날짜 변경에는 의견이 달라요.

language_specific.morphology: 의견 + 이 marks the subject; 다르- + -아요 changes irregularly to 달라요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 날짜 변경에는 의견이 다르다 identifies the remaining disagreement.

common.sentence: 복도에 둔 자전거 때문에 지나가기 힘드네요.
common.meaning: it is hard to get past

language_specific.morphology: 지나가- + -기 nominalizes the action; 힘들- + -네요 presents the difficulty as an observation.
language_specific.social_context: The stated obstruction can hint that the bicycle should be moved.

common.sentence: 도서관이라 그런데 통화 소리를 조금 낮춰 주실래요?

language_specific.morphology: 낮추- + -어 contracts to 낮춰; 주- + -시- + -ㄹ래요 makes a polite request.
language_specific.social_context: A person asks another library user to lower their voice.

common.sentence: 혹시 가능하면 우산을 빌려주실 수 있을까요?

language_specific.social_context: The condition leaves room for the other person to decline the loan.

common.sentence: 지금 시간 있으세요? 있으시면 상자 옮기는 걸 도와주실래요?

language_specific.morphology: 시간 is the subject with 이 omitted; 있- + -으시- + -어요 becomes 있으세요.
language_specific.social_context: The help request is conditional on the other person's availability.

common.sentence: 그 시간에 병원 예약이 있어서 약속을 한 시간 늦출까요?
common.meaning: shall we move it one hour later?

language_specific.morphology: 한 시간 specifies the amount of delay; 늦추- + -ㄹ까요 proposes the change.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 약속을 한 시간 늦추다 means to move an appointment one hour later.

common.sentence: 부담되시면 거절하셔도 돼요. 발표를 맡아 주실래요?

language_specific.morphology: 거절하- + -시- + -어도 becomes 거절하셔도; 돼요 expresses permission.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker explicitly leaves the listener room to refuse the request.

common.sentence: 선생님, 제 추천서를 써 주실래요?
common.meaning: would you write it for me?

language_specific.morphology: 쓰- + -어 gives 써 with ㅡ deletion; 주- + -시- + -ㄹ래요 forms the respectful request 주실래요.
language_specific.social_context: A learner asks a teacher to write a recommendation.

common.sentence: 민수야, 친구니까 부탁해. 내일 내 고양이 밥 좀 줘.

language_specific.morphology: 밥 is the object with 을 omitted; 좀 softens the request, and 주- + -어 contracts to 줘.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks a friend to feed their cat.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 고양이에게 밥을 주다 means to feed a cat.

common.sentence: 저녁 초대는 고맙지만 먼저 잡은 약속이 있어서 못 가요.

language_specific.morphology: 못 precedes 가다 to express inability; 가- + -아요 becomes 가요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker declines the invitation because of an earlier commitment.

common.sentence: 오늘 보고서 전체는 맡을 여력이 없어요. 표는 확인할게요.
common.meaning: lack the capacity to take it on

language_specific.morphology: 맡- + -을 modifies 여력; 여력 + 이 is the subject of 없다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 맡을 여력이 없다 means to lack capacity to take on a task.

common.sentence: 밤새 운전하자는 제안은 피곤해서 망설여져요. 이번엔 사양할게요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 제안은 ... 망설여져요: the speaker feels hesitant about the proposal, then explicitly declines it.
language_specific.morphology: 망설이- + -어지다 gives 망설여지다; 망설여지- + -어요 contracts to 망설여져요.

common.sentence: 짐은 들어 드리지만 차로 데려다드리지는 못해요.

language_specific.morphology: 데려다드리- + -지는 못하다 contrasts the refused action with the help offered.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker offers to carry the luggage but declines to provide a ride.

common.sentence: 상담은 지금은 못 하지만 내일은 할 수 있어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 지금은 못 하지만 내일은 할 수 있다: cannot do it now but can do it tomorrow.
language_specific.morphology: 지금 + 은 contrasts the present time; 못 하- + -지만 gives 못 하지만, limiting the inability to now.

common.sentence: 일이 일찍 끝나면 이사를 도울지도 몰라요.

language_specific.morphology: 돕- + -을지도 gives 도울지도 through ㅂ irregular inflection; 모르- + -아요 becomes 몰라요 through 르 irregular inflection.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 일이 끝나면 도울지도 모르다: might help if the work finishes.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 도울지도 [도울찌도]; ㅈ is tense after ㄹ in this complex ending.

common.sentence: 엄마, 자꾸 노크 없이 들어오셔서 곤란해요. 들어오기 전에 노크해 주세요.

language_specific.morphology: 노크하- + -여 contracts to 노크해; 주세요 forms the polite request.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker politely asks their mother to knock after repeated entries without knocking.

common.sentence: 이 편지는 개인적인 이야기라서 다른 사람에게 보여 주지 마세요.

language_specific.morphology: 보이- + -어 contracts to 보여; 주- + -지 combines with 말다 in 마세요, where ㄹ drops before 시.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 다른 사람에게 보여 주지 마세요: politely ask that it not be shown to others.

common.sentence: 저는 주민 대표로서 회의에서 정한 대로 공사 연장을 거절합니다.

language_specific.social_context: The residents' representative communicates the decision made at their meeting.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 대표로서 marks the capacity in which the speaker conveys the group's decision.

common.sentence: 참석이 힘들다고 하셨는데, 거절하신다는 뜻인가요?
common.part_of_speech: honorific modifier and copular question phrase

language_specific.morphology: 거절하- + -시- + -ㄴ다는 forms the honorific reported modifier 거절하신다는; 뜻 + 이- + -ㄴ가요 asks whether that is the intended meaning.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker checks whether the indirect response means that the other person is declining.

common.sentence: 못 오신다고요? 알겠어요, 알려 주셔서 고마워요.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker accepts the other person's inability to attend and thanks them for saying so.

common.sentence: 제가 동의한 건 아니에요. 자료만 검토하겠다고 말씀드렸어요.
common.meaning: that I would only review the materials

language_specific.morphology: 자료 + 만 limits the object; 검토하- + -겠- + -다고 reports the speaker's stated intention.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker corrects an inference of agreement while restating the limited commitment.

common.sentence: 엄마, 전보다 밥을 자주 남겨서 마음이 쓰여.

language_specific.morphology: 마음이 쓰여 is 마음이 쓰이다 with 쓰이- + -어 contracted to 쓰여.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 마음이 쓰이다: be concerned about someone or something.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses casual speech with their mother, addressed as 엄마.

common.sentence: 친구에게: 요즘 어떻게 지내? 말하기 싫으면 안 해도 돼.

language_specific.morphology: 어떻게 지내 combines 어떻게 with 지내- + -어, contracted to 지내.
language_specific.social_context: One friend checks in with another and leaves disclosure optional.

common.sentence: 엄마, 원하면 내가 약국에 대신 다녀올까?
common.meaning: offer to go in someone's place

language_specific.morphology: 대신 다녀올까 combines 대신 with 다녀오- + -ㄹ까, an offer framed as a question.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 어디에 대신 다녀오다: go somewhere in someone's place and return.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses casual speech with their mother, addressed as 엄마.

common.sentence: 언니, 그냥 들어 줄까, 아니면 해결책을 같이 찾아볼까?

language_specific.morphology: 들어 줄까 combines 듣- + -어, with ㄷ changing to ㄹ, and 주- + -ㄹ까.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이야기를 들어 주다: listen to someone's story for them.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses casual speech with a familiar older woman addressed as 언니.

common.sentence: 친구에게: 네가 '넌 쓸모없어'라고 해서 상처받았어. 일부러 그랬는지는 모르겠어.

language_specific.social_context: One friend describes being hurt without claiming to know the other's intent.
language_specific.lexical_frame: -라고 해서 상처받다: be hurt because someone said something.

common.sentence: 언니, 발표 준비에 정말 애썼어. 결과와 별개로 자랑스러워.

language_specific.morphology: 애썼어 is 애쓰- + -었어; the stem vowel ㅡ drops before 어.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 일에 애쓰다: put effort into a task.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses casual speech with a familiar older woman addressed as 언니.

common.sentence: 언니, 면접이 걱정되면 오늘 예상 질문을 같이 살펴볼게.
common.meaning: offer to look over something together

language_specific.morphology: 같이 살펴볼게 combines 같이 with 살펴보- + -ㄹ게, expressing the speaker's offered action.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 무엇을 같이 살펴보다: examine something together.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses casual speech with a familiar older woman addressed as 언니.

common.sentence: 언니, 도움이 필요 없다고 했으니 더 권하지 않을게.

language_specific.morphology: 권하지 않을게 combines 권하- + -지 않다 with 않- + -을게, expressing the speaker's decision not to press the offer.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 더 권하지 않다: not press an offer further.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses casual speech with a familiar older woman addressed as 언니.

common.sentence: 언니, 지금 개인적인 얘기를 꺼내도 될까?
common.meaning: ask if one may bring up a topic

language_specific.morphology: 얘기를 꺼내도 될까 combines 꺼내- + -어도, contracted to 꺼내도, with 되- + -ㄹ까.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker addresses an older sister or a woman they call 언니.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 얘기를 꺼내다: bring up a topic.

common.sentence: 매일 병원에 오가느라 지치겠어요. 힘드시겠어요.

language_specific.morphology: 힘드시겠어요 is 힘들- + -시- + -겠어요; ㄹ drops before 시.

common.sentence: 언니, 모임이 부담스럽다면 내가 곁에 있을게.

language_specific.morphology: 곁에 있을게 combines 곁에 with 있- + -을게, expressing the speaker's offer.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 곁에 있다: stay by someone's side.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses casual speech with a familiar older woman addressed as 언니.

common.sentence: 언니, 공모전에서 떨어져 속상하지. 쉬었다가 다시 도전해 봐.
common.meaning: try taking on a challenge again

language_specific.morphology: 다시 도전해 봐 combines 도전하- + -여, contracted to 도전해, with 보- + -아, contracted to 봐.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 무엇에 다시 도전하다: take on a challenge again.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses casual speech with a familiar older woman addressed as 언니.

common.sentence: 이사가 기대도 되지만 동네를 떠나기 아쉬워요.
common.meaning: although I am also looking forward to it

language_specific.morphology: 기대도 되지만 combines 기대 + 도 with 되- + -지만, contrasting anticipation with another feeling.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 기대도 되지만 아쉽다: feel anticipation and regret.

common.sentence: 그 글에서 '무능하다'는 표현이 너무 거칠어요.

language_specific.morphology: 표현이 너무 거칠어요 combines the subject 표현이, 너무, and 거칠- + -어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 표현이 거칠다: wording is harsh.

common.sentence: 엄마, 제 체중 얘기는 부드럽게 말씀해 주세요. 듣기 힘들어요.

language_specific.morphology: 부드럽- + -게 forms 부드럽게 with ㅂ retained before the consonant ending; 말씀하- + -여 contracts to 말씀해, followed by 주세요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker politely asks their mother to change how she discusses the speaker's weight.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 부드럽게 말씀하다: speak gently.

common.sentence: 친구에게: 농담하려던 거였지만 네가 상처받은 건 사실이야.
common.meaning: I intended it as a joke, but

language_specific.morphology: 농담하려던 거였지만 combines 농담하- + -려고 하던, contracted to 농담하려던, with 것 + 이었지만, contracted to 거였지만.
language_specific.social_context: One friend acknowledges the effect of a remark despite their intention.

common.sentence: 동료: 설명이 길었어요. 나: 어느 부분을 줄일까요?

language_specific.morphology: 어느 부분을 줄일까요 combines 어느 부분을 with 줄이- + -ㄹ까요, asking for guidance.
language_specific.social_context: A colleague gives feedback and the speaker asks for a concrete improvement.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 부분을 줄이다: shorten a part.

common.sentence: 친구: 네 비밀을 말해서 미안해, 말이 안 나와. 나: 사과해 줘서 고마워.

language_specific.morphology: 사과하- + -여 contracts to 사과해; 주- + -어서 contracts to 줘서, giving the reason for thanks. 고맙- + -어 gives 고마워 through ㅂ irregular conjugation.
language_specific.social_context: A friend awkwardly apologizes for sharing a secret; the speaker appreciates the apology.

common.sentence: 친구: 내 이야기 남에게 말하지 마. 나: 응, 누구에게도 말하지 않을게.

language_specific.morphology: 누구에게도 말하지 않을게 combines 누구에게도 with 말하- + -지 않- + -을게, expressing a commitment.
language_specific.social_context: One friend asks the other to keep a personal story private.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 누구에게도 말하지 않다: tell no one.

common.sentence: 언니, 어제 병원까지 같이 가 줘서 고마워.

language_specific.morphology: 같이 가 줘서 combines 가- + -아, contracted to 가, with 주- + -어서, contracted to 줘서.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 어디까지 같이 가 주다: accompany someone to a place.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses casual speech with a familiar older woman addressed as 언니.

common.sentence: 언니, 민수라고 했지? 내가 잘못 말했어, 민지라고 해야 해.

language_specific.morphology: 잘못 말했어 combines 잘못 with 말하- + -였어, contracted to 말했어.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이름을 잘못 말하다: say a name incorrectly.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses casual speech with a familiar older woman addressed as 언니.

common.sentence: 언니, 민지와 수현 중에 '그 사람'은 누구를 가리켜?

language_specific.morphology: 누구를 가리켜 combines 누구를 with 가리키- + -어, contracted to 가리켜.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 누구를 가리키다: refer to a person.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses casual speech with a familiar older woman addressed as 언니.

common.sentence: 보고서는 제가 팀장님께 보내라는 말씀이세요?
common.meaning: that I should send it to the team leader

language_specific.morphology: 제가 팀장님께 보내라는 uses 보내- + -라는 to modify 말씀 and identify the requested sender and recipient.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker checks an instruction involving the team leader.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 제가 팀장님께 보내다: I send something to the team leader.

common.sentence: 언니, 오늘 준다고 들었구나. 내가 약속한 건 내일이야.

language_specific.morphology: 약속한 건 내일이야 combines 약속하- + -ㄴ with 것은 contracted to 건 and 내일이야.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses casual speech with a familiar older woman addressed as 언니.

common.sentence: 동료: 아무도 안 오나요? 나: 몇 명은 오지만 전부 오지는 않아요.

language_specific.morphology: 전부 오지는 않아요 combines 전부 with 오- + -지는 않아요; it negates the claim that everyone is coming, without saying that nobody is coming.
language_specific.social_context: Colleagues clarify how many people are coming.

common.sentence: 언니, 내 설명이 모호했어. 금요일까지 초안만 보내면 돼.

language_specific.morphology: 설명이 모호했어 combines 설명이 with 모호하- + -였어, contracted to 모호했어.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 설명이 모호하다: an explanation is unclear.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses casual speech with a familiar older woman addressed as 언니.

common.sentence: 친구에게: 아까 네 의견을 한심하다고 해서 미안해.

language_specific.morphology: 해서 미안해 combines 하- + -여서, contracted to 해서, with 미안하- + -여, contracted to 미안해.
language_specific.social_context: One friend apologizes for calling the other's opinion pathetic.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 한심하다고 해서 미안해: apologize for calling something pathetic.

common.sentence: 언니, 다들 반대한다는 말은 취소할게. 두 명이 반대했어.

language_specific.morphology: 말은 취소할게 combines 말은 with 취소하- + -ㄹ게, expressing the speaker's withdrawal.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 말을 취소하다: take back a statement.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses casual speech with a familiar older woman addressed as 언니.

common.sentence: 제가 반대한다고 전해졌지만, 저는 연기를 제안했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 연기를 제안했어요 combines 연기를 with 제안하- + -였어요, contracted to 제안했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 연기를 제안하다: propose postponement.

common.sentence: 세 시는 대략 잡은 시간이었어요. 확정한 약속은 아니었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 대략 잡은 시간 combines 대략 with 잡- + -은 modifying 시간.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 시간을 대략 잡다: set or estimate a time roughly.

common.sentence: 선생님, 방금 '너'라고 했네요. 선생님이라고 불러야 했어요.
common.meaning: should have addressed someone as teacher

language_specific.morphology: 선생님이라고 marks the quoted form of address; 불러야 했어요 combines 부르- + -어야, with 르 irregularity, and 하- + -였어요.
language_specific.social_context: A learner corrects an overfamiliar form of address used toward a teacher.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 선생님이라고 부르다: address someone as 선생님.

common.sentence: 제가 할머니께 책을 '주셨어요'가 아니라 '드렸어요'라고 해야 해요.

language_specific.morphology: 드렸어요 is 드리- + -었어요, contracted to 드렸어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker explicitly identifies themself as the giver and their grandmother as recipient; 드렸어요 humbles the speaker in relation to her.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 할머니께 책을 드리다: give a book to one's grandmother.

common.sentence: 마지막 장소를 못 들었어요. 한 번만 다시 말씀해 주시겠어요?
common.meaning: ask someone to say something again

language_specific.morphology: 다시 말씀해 주시겠어요 combines 말씀하- + -여, contracted to 말씀해, with 주- + -시겠어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 무엇을 다시 말씀해 주다: say something again for the listener.

common.sentence: 수정할 게 있을 때만 다시 보내라는 뜻이죠?
common.meaning: you mean I should resend it, right?

language_specific.morphology: 보내- + -라는 reports a command modifying 뜻; 뜻 + 이- + -지요 contracts to 뜻이죠, checking an interpretation. 다시 means again.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 수정할 게 있을 때만 다시 보내라는 뜻이다: interpret the instruction as resending only when revision is needed; the condition remains visible.

common.sentence: 동료: 끄덕였으니 동의한 거죠? 나: 동의한 건 아니에요, 아직 고민 중이에요.

language_specific.morphology: 동의한 건 아니에요 combines 동의하- + -ㄴ with 것은, contracted to 건, and 아니에요.
language_specific.social_context: A colleague interprets a nod as agreement; the speaker says the decision is still unsettled.

common.sentence: 언니, 약속에 늦은 행동을 지적한 거야. 네 성격 얘기는 아니야.

language_specific.morphology: 행동을 지적한 거야 combines 지적하- + -ㄴ with 것이야 contracted to 거야.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 행동을 지적하다: point out a behavior as an issue.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses casual speech with a familiar older woman addressed as 언니.

common.sentence: 동료: 비난처럼 들렸어요. 나: 그렇게 들렸군요, 일정 변경을 제안한 거였어요.
common.meaning: I see it sounded that way

language_specific.morphology: 그렇게 들렸군요 combines 그렇게 with 들리- + -었군요, contracted to 들렸군요.
language_specific.social_context: A colleague reports hearing blame; the speaker acknowledges that reaction and clarifies the proposal.

common.sentence: 회의실이 2층이 아니라 3층이군요. 바로잡아 주셔서 고마워요.
common.meaning: so it is the third floor
common.part_of_speech: floor noun with copula and acknowledgment ending

language_specific.morphology: 3층 + 이- + -군요 acknowledges the corrected floor; the Arabic numeral is read 삼.

common.sentence: '더 명확하게'라는 지시가 막연해요. 예를 들어 주시겠어요?

language_specific.morphology: 예 + 를 forms the object; 들- + -어 gives 들어, followed by 주- + -시- + -겠어요 as a respectful request.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 예를 들다: give an example.

common.sentence: 언니, 그러면 모임은 토요일이네. 응, 이제 오해가 풀렸어.

language_specific.morphology: 오해가 풀렸어 combines 오해가 with 풀리- + -었어, contracted to 풀렸어.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 오해가 풀리다: a misunderstanding is cleared up.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses casual speech with a familiar older woman addressed as 언니.

common.sentence: 동생은 재즈를 좋아하는구나. 나는 클래식이 더 좋아.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker acknowledges a younger sibling's taste and states a different preference.

common.sentence: 친구에게: 요즘 별일 없지? 답장은 편할 때 해.

language_specific.morphology: 편하- + -ㄹ 때 marks a convenient time; 해 is the casual form of 하다.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker checks in with a friend and leaves the timing of a reply open.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 답장은 편할 때 해: reply when convenient.

common.sentence: 이모, 초대 고마워요. 그날 일해서 못 가지만 다음에 만나요.

language_specific.morphology: 못 precedes 가- + -지만, expressing inability followed by a contrasting response.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker declines an aunt's invitation and suggests meeting later.

common.sentence: 여보, 이번 주 설거지는 내가 다 했어. 나눠서 하자.

language_specific.morphology: 나누- + -어서 contracts to 나눠서; 하자 is the casual suggestion form of 하다.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker raises a household imbalance with their spouse.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 일을 나눠서 하다: divide a task among people.

common.sentence: 엄마는 유학 말고 취업하래. 걱정은 고맙지만 나는 유학할래.

language_specific.morphology: 걱정 + topic particle 은 identifies the concern; 고맙- + -지만 gives 고맙지만, introducing a contrast.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker treats their mother's advice as concern and expresses appreciation while retaining their own choice to study abroad.

common.sentence: 우리 모임 연장자: 고전 영화가 좋아요. 나: 그걸로 같이 봐요.

language_specific.morphology: 그것 + 으로 contracts to 그걸로, a standard noun/particle contraction; 같이 means together, and 보- + -아요 contracts to 봐요 for the suggestion.
language_specific.social_context: An older group member states a preference, and another member proposes watching that kind of film together.

common.sentence: 이 소설은 결말이 급해요. 좋아하는 분도 있겠지만요.

language_specific.morphology: 결말이 is the subject; 급하- + -여요 contracts to 급해요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 결말이 급하다: an ending feels rushed.

common.sentence: 소설 속 인물이 동생을 돕는 걸 보고 다시 봤어요.

language_specific.morphology: 보- + -았어요 contracts to 봤어요; 다시 marks a renewed assessment here.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 인물을 다시 보다: reassess a character.

common.sentence: 작가는 “조용했다”고 썼어요. 저는 외로움으로 읽었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 외로움 + -으로 marks the interpretation; 읽- + -었어요 gives 읽었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 표현을 외로움으로 읽다: interpret wording as conveying loneliness.

common.sentence: 다른 회원도 우리 모임 책이 필요해서 빌리기가 망설여져요.

language_specific.morphology: 빌리- + -기 nominalizes borrowing; 망설여지- + -어요 contracts to 망설여져요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 책을 빌리기가 망설여지다: hesitate to borrow a book.

common.sentence: 친구에게: 이삿짐 옮겨 줘서 정말 고마워.

language_specific.morphology: 옮기- + -어 gives 옮겨; 주- + -어서 contracts to 줘서, marking the favor as the reason for thanks.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker warmly thanks a friend for moving belongings.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 옮겨 줘서 [옴겨 줘서]; the ㄻ cluster is pronounced ㅁ before ㄱ.

common.sentence: 친구에게: 자꾸 늦어서 밖에서 기다리기 좀 힘들어.
common.meaning: it is a little hard to wait

language_specific.morphology: 기다리- + -기 nominalizes waiting; 좀 softens 힘들- + -어, which gives 힘들어.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker raises the inconvenience indirectly with a friend who keeps arriving late.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 밖에서 기다리기 힘들다: find it hard to wait outside.

common.sentence: 친구에게: 조언은 못 해도 네 얘기는 들을게.
common.meaning: even if I cannot give advice

language_specific.morphology: 조언은 marks advice as the contrasted topic; 못 해도 combines 못 하다 with concessive -어도.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker offers a friend a hearing while limiting the offer of advice.

common.sentence: 삼촌, 제 연봉은 말씀드리고 싶지 않아요.

language_specific.morphology: 말씀드리- + -고 싶지 않아요 expresses an unwillingness to tell an honored listener.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker sets a boundary with an uncle.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 연봉을 말씀드리다: tell an honored listener one's salary.

common.sentence: 선배님 글의 제목을 바꾸자고 제안해도 될까요?

language_specific.morphology: 제안하- + -여도 contracts to 제안해도; 되- + -ㄹ까요 asks for permission.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks a senior before suggesting a change to the senior's writing.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 바꾸자고 제안하다: suggest changing something.

common.sentence: 친구: 오늘 차 태워 줄게. 나: 고마워, 오늘 부탁할게.
common.meaning: I'll take you up on it today

language_specific.morphology: 부탁하- + -ㄹ게 gives 부탁할게, accepting the offered help for today.
language_specific.social_context: A friend offers a ride today, and the speaker accepts that offer.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 오늘 부탁할게: accept the help offered for today.

common.sentence: 친구에게: 이 년 만에 다시 만나니 정말 반가워.

language_specific.morphology: 만나- + -니 connects meeting again to the speaker's reaction.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker welcomes a reunion with a friend after two years.

common.sentence: 오늘 독서 모임은 토론 시간이 좀 짧아 아쉬웠어요.
common.meaning: it was disappointing that it was short

language_specific.morphology: 짧- + -아 gives the reason; 아쉽- + -었어요 gives 아쉬웠어요, with ㅂ irregularity.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 시간이 짧아 아쉽다: feel disappointed that there was little time.

common.sentence: 친구에게: 넌 바다가 좋지만 난 산이 좋아. 산도 고려해 줄래?

language_specific.morphology: 고려하- + -여 contracts to 고려해; 주- + -ㄹ래 asks a casual question about willingness.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks a friend to consider the speaker's preference.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 산도 고려해 주다: also consider the mountains.

common.sentence: 친구에게: 넌 그 영화가 좋았구나. 난 별로지만 네 취향도 존중해.

language_specific.morphology: 취향 + -도 marks the friend's taste as also worthy of respect; 존중하- + -여 contracts to 존중해.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker acknowledges a friend's different opinion of a film amicably.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 취향을 존중하다: respect someone's taste.

common.sentence: 창밖의 나무에 새가 앉아 있어요.

language_specific.morphology: 앉- + -아 있다 describes the resulting state of sitting; 있어요 is informal polite.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 나무에 앉아 있다: be perched in a tree.

common.sentence: 여보, 거실 창문이 열려 있어서 추워.

language_specific.morphology: 열리- + -어 gives 열려; 있- + -어서 marks the open state as the reason.
language_specific.social_context: Addressed to a spouse in the shared living room, the observation can suggest closing the window.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 창문이 열려 있다: a window is open.

common.sentence: 친구에게: 우산을 빌려준 덕분에 안 젖었어. 고마워!
common.meaning: thanks to your help, I stayed dry

language_specific.morphology: 덕분에 marks a beneficial cause; 안 negates 젖- + -었어, giving the casual past 젖었어.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker sincerely thanks a friend for lending an umbrella.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 덕분에 안 젖다: stay dry thanks to someone's help.

common.sentence: 그 제안은 조금 더 생각한 뒤에 답해도 될까요?

language_specific.morphology: 생각하- + -ㄴ modifies 뒤; -에 marks the time after consideration.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks to defer a response to a proposal.

common.sentence: 동생아, 대회에서 우승했다니 정말 대단해!

language_specific.morphology: 대단하- + -여 contracts to 대단해; 정말 intensifies the praise.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker praises a younger sibling for winning a competition.

common.sentence: 동생에게: 주스를 또 쏟았네. 참 깔끔하다!

language_specific.morphology: 참 modifies 깔끔하다, whose plain ending is used here in a casual comment.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker makes a mild ironic comment to a younger sibling after juice is spilled.

common.sentence: 제 펜을 써도 돼요. 필요하면 쓰세요.

language_specific.morphology: 쓰- + -어도 gives 써도; 되- + -어요 gives 돼요, granting permission.
language_specific.social_context: The owner permits the listener to use the pen if needed.

common.sentence: 짐이 무거운데 문 좀 열 수 있어요?

language_specific.morphology: 열- + -ㄹ keeps one ㄹ in 열; 수 있어요 asks about ability, serving as a request in this situation.
language_specific.social_context: A person carrying heavy luggage asks someone to open the door.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 문을 열 수 있어요?: can you open the door?

common.sentence: 친구에게: 밤새 아팠다니 지금은 좀 나아졌어?
common.meaning: have you gotten a little better?

language_specific.morphology: 낫- + -아지다 gives 나아지다, with ㅅ irregularity; -었어 marks the change as past.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks a friend about their condition after a difficult night.

common.sentence: 동생아, 네가 계속 밥을 거르니 걱정돼.

language_specific.morphology: 거르- + -니 gives 거르니 and connects the repeated behavior to the speaker's concern.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker raises concern about a younger sibling's repeated behavior.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 밥을 거르다: skip a meal.

common.sentence: 제목에는 3월인데 본문에는 4월이네요. 확인해 주실래요?

language_specific.morphology: 확인하- + -여 contracts to 확인해; 주- + honorific -시- + -ㄹ래요 forms a polite request.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker tactfully draws attention to conflicting dates.

common.sentence: 안내문에 장소가 없네요. 모임은 어디에서 열려요?

language_specific.morphology: 어디에서 asks for a location; 열리- + -어요 gives 열려요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 모임이 어디에서 열리다: a meeting takes place somewhere.

common.sentence: 말씀은 들었어요. 하지만 그 방안에 찬성하지는 않아요.
common.meaning: I have heard what you said

language_specific.morphology: 말씀은 marks the words as a contrasted topic; 듣- + -었어요 gives 들었어요, with ㄷ irregularity.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker acknowledges hearing the proposal while explicitly withholding agreement.

common.sentence: 회의를 금요일에 여는 데는 저도 찬성해요.

language_specific.morphology: 찬성하- + -여요 contracts to 찬성해요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 회의를 금요일에 여는 데 찬성하다: agree to hold the meeting on Friday.

common.sentence: 친구에게: 원하면 내가 발표 자료를 살펴볼까?

language_specific.social_context: The speaker tentatively offers to review a friend's presentation materials.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 발표 자료를 살펴보다: look over presentation materials.

common.sentence: 친구에게: 오늘 저녁에 사진을 꼭 보낼게.

language_specific.morphology: 보내- + -ㄹ게 gives 보낼게, expressing a commitment to the listener; 꼭 reinforces it.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker promises a friend to send the photo that evening.

common.sentence: 친구에게: 약속이 갑자기 취소돼서 좀 짜증 났어.

language_specific.morphology: 짜증 나- + -았어 contracts to 짜증 났어, a casual past expression of annoyance.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker tells a friend how the sudden cancellation felt.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 짜증이 나다: feel annoyed.

common.sentence: 이제 가 봐야겠어요. 다음에 또 이야기해요.

language_specific.morphology: 가- + -아 보다 gives 가 보다; 보- + -아야겠다 contracts to 봐야겠다, with -어요 giving 봐야겠어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker politely closes the current conversation.

common.sentence: “시간이 늦었네요”는 가자는 뜻일 수도 있어요.

language_specific.morphology: 뜻 + 이다 + -ㄹ 수 있다 gives 뜻일 수 있다; 도 allows this as one possible interpretation.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 가자는 뜻일 수도 있다: could mean that the speaker wants to leave.

common.sentence: 다시 확인했으니 금요일에 만나기로 한 거죠?

language_specific.morphology: 만나- + -기로 하다 expresses a decision; 한 거죠 asks for confirmation of that decision.
language_specific.social_context: After checking again, the speaker confirms the shared meeting decision.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 금요일에 만나기로 하다: decide to meet on Friday.

common.sentence: 동료가 회의에서 쓰도록 자료를 정리해 두었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 정리하- + -여 → 정리해; 두- + -었어요 → 두었어요. The -어 두다 pattern records an action done in preparation with its result retained.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 자료를 정리해 두다: organize materials and keep them ready.

common.sentence: 동료가 나중에 볼 수 있게 원본을 찾아 두었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 찾- + -아 gives 찾아; 두- + -었어요 gives 두었어요. The completed search leaves the original available for later use.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 원본을 찾아 두다: find the original and keep it available.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 찾아 두었어요 [차자 두어써요]; final ㅈ links to 아, and past ㅆ links to 어요.

common.sentence: 회의 전에 발표용 화면을 준비해 두시겠어요?

language_specific.morphology: 준비하- + -여 → 준비해; 두- + -시- + -겠어요 → 두시겠어요. The -해 두다 pattern requests preparation before use.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker makes a respectful request to the listener.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 회의실 열쇠는 안내 데스크에 맡겨 뒀어요.

language_specific.morphology: 맡기- + -어 → 맡겨; 두- + -었- → 뒀-. The -어 두다 pattern reports a completed preparation whose result remains available.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker reports to a team leader.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 열쇠를 안내 데스크에 맡겨 두다: leave a key in the reception desk's care.

common.sentence: 팀원들이 볼 수 있게 게시판에 일정을 적어 놓았어요.

language_specific.morphology: 적- + -어 → 적어; 놓- + -았어요 → 놓았어요. The -어 놓다 pattern presents the writing as completed and its result as remaining.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 게시판에 일정을 적어 놓다: write the schedule on a board and leave it there.

common.sentence: 회의 때 쓰려고 제가 의자를 복도에 쌓아 놓았어요.
common.meaning: have stacked and left in place

language_specific.morphology: 쌓- + -아 gives 쌓아; 놓- + -았어요 gives 놓았어요. The completed stacking leaves the chairs available for the meeting.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 의자를 복도에 쌓아 놓다: stack chairs in the corridor and leave them there.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 쌓아 놓았어요 [싸아 노아써요]; ㅎ drops before vowel-initial endings, and past ㅆ links to 어요.

common.sentence: 부장님이 보시도록 수정본을 저장해 놓았어요.

language_specific.morphology: 저장하- + -여 → 저장해; 놓- + -았어요 → 놓았어요. The -해 놓다 pattern preserves the completed result.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker honors the department head as the person who will view the revision.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 제가 출입증을 서랍에 넣어 놨어요.
common.meaning: have put and left in place

language_specific.morphology: 넣- + -어 → 넣어; 놓- + -았- → 놨-. The -어 놓다 pattern reports a completed action with its result still in place.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker tells the team leader where the speaker left the access card.

common.sentence: 제가 회의실을 열 테니 참석자들을 안내해 주세요.

language_specific.morphology: 열- + -ㄹ 테니 → 열 테니: the stem-final ㄹ is retained before 테니. The pattern states the speaker's intention as the basis for the request.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker undertakes opening the meeting room and politely asks the listener to guide the attendees; no particular rank is asserted.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 회의실을 열 테니: I'll open the meeting room, so.

common.sentence: 제가 명단을 읽을 테니 좌석을 살펴봐 주세요.

language_specific.morphology: 읽- + -을 테니 gives 읽을 테니; a non-ㄹ consonant stem takes -을. The speaker’s intended reading enables the coordinated request.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker undertakes reading the list and politely asks the listener to check the seating; no invented rank or title.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 읽을 테니 [일글 테니]; ㄺ splits before the vowel, retaining ㄹ as coda and linking ㄱ to 을.

common.sentence: 짐이 많아서 무거울 테니 카트를 쓰세요.
common.meaning: it will likely be heavy, so

language_specific.morphology: 무겁- + -을 테니 → 무거울 테니: ㅂ changes to 우 before the vowel. The conjecture supports the suggestion.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 무거울 테니 카트를 쓰다: use a cart because the load will likely be heavy.

common.sentence: 방금 회의가 끝났어요. 다들 지쳤을 테니 잠시 쉬게 해요.

language_specific.morphology: 지치- + -었- contracts to 지쳤-; -을 테니 presents the recent resulting fatigue as a conjecture supporting the suggestion, not known private experience.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 교육에 쓸 노트북은 준비됐어요.

language_specific.morphology: 준비되- + -었어요 → 준비됐어요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker reports to a team leader.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 교육에 쓸 노트북이 준비되다: the laptop for training is ready.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 초안은 예비 검토만 했고 최종 승인은 남았어요.
common.meaning: only conducted a preliminary review, and

language_specific.morphology: 예비 검토 + 만 + 하- + -였- + -고 → 예비 검토만 했고. 만 limits the completed action.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker gives a bounded update to the team leader.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 초안은 예비 검토만 하다: perform only a preliminary review of the draft; 만 attaches to the noun phrase before independent 하다.

common.sentence: 부장님, 초안과 수정본 중 어느 쪽을 쓸까요?

language_specific.morphology: 쓰- + -ㄹ까요 → 쓸까요: asks for the listener's direction on an intended action.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks a department head to choose between the two versions.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 초안과 수정본 중 어느 쪽을 쓰다: use which of the draft and the revision.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 인계 전에 명단이 빠진 걸 발견해서 추가할게요.
common.meaning: having found that it was missing

language_specific.morphology: 빠지- + -ㄴ → 빠진; 발견하- + -여서 → 발견해서. 걸 is the contracted object form of 것을.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker flags an omission to the team leader before handover.

common.sentence: 맡으신 자료 정리, 제가 도와드릴까요?

language_specific.morphology: 돕- + -아 gives 도와 through the ㅂ irregular; 도와드리- + -ㄹ까요 forms a respectful offer. 도와드리다 is written together, following 도와주다.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker politely offers to help the listener with the task already assigned to them; no particular rank or familiarity is asserted.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 프린터가 고장 나 준비가 늦어져서 수리부터 요청하겠습니다.

language_specific.morphology: 늦어지- + -어서 → 늦어져서: links the delay to the stated next action.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker reports an obstacle and a limited next step to the team leader.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 준비가 늦어지다: preparation is delayed.

common.sentence: 공유 파일은 열 수 있지만 내용은 아직 검토 중이에요.

language_specific.morphology: 검토 + 중 + 이- + -에요 → 검토 중이에요: indicates a review in progress.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 내용이 검토 중이다: the contents are under review.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 회의 준비 중 제가 맡은 부분은 끝났습니다.
common.meaning: as for the part assigned to me

language_specific.morphology: 맡- + -은 → 맡은, modifying 부분; 은 marks that part as the topic.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker limits the readiness report to their own assigned preparation for the team leader.

common.sentence: 부장님께 수정한 계약서를 오늘 보내 드리겠습니다.

language_specific.morphology: 보내- + -어 → 보내; 드리- + -겠- + -습니다 → 드리겠습니다. 드리다 presents the action as a benefit to the recipient.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker commits to sending the revised contract to the department head.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 부장님께 계약서를 보내 드리다: send a contract to the department head respectfully.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 수치를 확인한 뒤 결과를 보고하겠습니다.

language_specific.morphology: 확인하- + -ㄴ → 확인한; 뒤 indicates the subsequent time.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker promises a report to the team leader after checking the figures.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 수치를 확인한 뒤 결과를 보고하다: report the results after checking the figures.

common.sentence: 운영팀을 대신해 장소 변경 소식을 전달해 드릴까요?

language_specific.morphology: 대신하- + -여 → 대신해: identifies the party on whose behalf the speaker offers to act.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker respectfully offers to relay the operations team's venue-change news.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 운영팀을 대신해 소식을 전달하다: relay news on behalf of the operations team.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 이 업무는 어디까지 맡으면 될까요?
common.meaning: how much should I take on

language_specific.morphology: 맡- + -으면 되다 + -ㄹ까요 asks what scope would be appropriate.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks the team leader to clarify the task's scope.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 업무를 어디까지 맡다: take on a task up to what point.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 프로젝트 전체는 아니지만 배정된 예산표는 제가 맡겠습니다.
common.meaning: I will take responsibility for the budget table

language_specific.morphology: 맡- + -겠- + -습니다 → 맡겠습니다: states an undertaking.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker accepts the assigned portion in a report to the team leader.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 예산표를 맡다: take responsibility for the budget table.

common.sentence: 부장님, 약속한 보고서는 드릴 수 있지만 추가 분석은 어렵습니다.
common.meaning: the additional analysis is beyond my capacity

language_specific.morphology: 어렵- + -습니다 → 어렵습니다: politely states difficulty with the additional work.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker distinguishes the promised report from the additional request when addressing the department head.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 추가 분석은 어렵다: the additional analysis is difficult to undertake.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 제가 작성한 표에서 오류를 발견해 해당 칸을 고치겠습니다.
common.meaning: I will correct the affected cell

language_specific.morphology: 고치- + -겠- + -습니다 → 고치겠습니다: states a limited corrective action.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker reports an error in their own table to the team leader.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 해당 칸을 고치다: correct the affected cell.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 답변 전에 개발팀에 문의해도 될까요?

language_specific.morphology: 문의하- + -여도 → 문의해도; 되- + -ㄹ까요 → 될까요. The pattern asks permission.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks the team leader for permission to consult the development team before responding.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 개발팀에 문의하다: consult the development team.

common.sentence: 부장님, 자료를 아직 못 받아서 초안은 내일쯤 가능할 듯합니다.
common.meaning: seems likely to be possible around tomorrow

language_specific.morphology: 가능하- + -ㄹ → 가능할; 듯합니다 presents the timing as an estimate.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker gives the department head a qualified estimate for the draft after a dependency delays it.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 알려 주신 기준으로 표를 다시 정리해 드릴까요?
common.meaning: shall I reorganize it for you

language_specific.morphology: 정리하- + -여 → 정리해; 드리- + -ㄹ까요 → 드릴까요. 드리다 marks the offered action as a benefit to the recipient.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker offers the team leader a follow-up based on the leader's guidance.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 기준으로 표를 다시 정리하다: reorganize a table using the criteria.

common.sentence: 부장님, 요청은 접수했고 작업은 아직 진행 전입니다.
common.meaning: I have received the request, and

language_specific.morphology: 접수하- + -였- + -고 → 접수했고: reports receipt and connects it to the work status.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker acknowledges the department head's request without claiming completion.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 요청을 접수하다: receive a request.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 최종 결과 전에 중간 보고를 드릴까요?
common.meaning: shall I give you an interim update

language_specific.morphology: 드리- + -ㄹ까요 → 드릴까요: offers an action for the listener's benefit.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks the team leader whether an interim report would be useful.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 중간 보고를 드리다: give a senior an interim report.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 기밀 명단은 제 계정에서만 열람하겠습니다.
common.meaning: I will access it only from my account

language_specific.morphology: 에서 + 만 limits where the speaker will access it; 열람하- + -겠- + -습니다 → 열람하겠습니다.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker commits to a personal handling practice for a confidential list.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 기밀 명단을 계정에서 열람하다: access a confidential list from an account.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 요청하신 날짜 확인에서는 문제가 없었습니다.

language_specific.morphology: 날짜 확인 + 에서 + 는 → 날짜 확인에서는: marks the check as the scope of the report.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker reports the result of the requested check to the team leader.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 날짜 확인에서 문제가 없다: find no issue in the date check.

common.sentence: 부장님, 오늘은 보고서와 명단 중 무엇부터 할까요?

language_specific.morphology: 무엇 + 부터 marks the first priority; 하- + -ㄹ까요 → 할까요 asks for direction.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks the department head to choose a priority for today.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 보고서와 명단 중 무엇부터 하다: decide which of the report and list to do first.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 제출한 문서의 승인된 내용은 두고 형식만 고쳐 드릴까요?
common.meaning: shall I correct only the format for you

language_specific.morphology: 형식 + 만 limits the change; 고치- + -어 → 고쳐 and 드리- + -ㄹ까요 → 드릴까요 form a respectful offer.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker offers the team leader a formatting correction while retaining the approved content.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 문서의 형식만 고치다: correct only the document's format.

common.sentence: 팀장님, 회의 때문에 보고서는 오늘 제출하기 어렵습니다. 내일 오전에 제출하겠습니다.
common.meaning: I will submit it tomorrow morning
